integrity: All connected labeled graphs through six vertices are enumerated. Distances are independently reconstructed by breadth-first search and Floyd--Warshall; betweenness is independently reconstructed by pairwise exact shortest-path counting and the exact Brandes recurrence; and all first-conflict graphs are canonicalized under every vertex permutation.
scientific_limitations: The exhaustive classification covers connected simple undirected graphs only through six vertices. The six-vertex threshold concerns distinct unique maximizers; maximizing sets can already differ through ties on five vertices. No claim is made about directed, weighted, disconnected, or larger graphs.
title: Six vertices are the sharp unique-maximizer split for degree and betweenness centrality
